_comment: Folder-role map per vault. Ships with the deployment, so a rename is a config change here rather than an edit scattered through the code. Roles not listed fall back to the standard vault layout (vault_layout.DEFAULTS). Any role can be overridden at runtime with VAULT_LAYOUT_<VAULT>_<ROLE>, which wins over this file.

personal-os._comment: The sensitive vault (.me), read over blob storage. Still carries the numbered PARA prefixes; delete the layout entries below in the same change that renames those folders.

mindvault._comment: The synced personal vault, read over the GitHub API. Migrated to the standard layout on 2026-07-30, so it needs no overrides.
